subject: Next steps: Dedicated throughput deep-dive & slot confirmation
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finserv-analytics.com>, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Dedicated throughput deep-dive & slot confirmation

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we can scope the dedicated sizing session:

- Primary goal: size a Dedicated Redwood pool to support FinServ Analytics' reconciliation and realtime enrichment workloads while meeting latency SLOs.
- Current expectation from your team: steady-state ~120 requests/sec, average response ~350 tokens, peak/burst up to ~300 req/sec during overnight reconciliation windows.
- Target perf: p95 end-to-end response latency goal <= 400ms for the median prompt mix; less than 600ms during the largest burst is acceptable with graceful fallback.
- Data notes: no sensitive PII in payloads; data residency required in US regions. SOC2 and standard security controls were mentioned.

To move forward, we'd like to run a focused Dedicated capacity deep-dive where we:
1) Confirm exact concurrency/peak windows and sequence-length distribution.
2) Agree perf targets, canary plan, and fallback model variants.
3) Walk through test harness and sample payload ingestion so we can run a representative load test.
4) Define mutual action items and target rollout timeline.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu May 27, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works for you and who from your side will join? If neither works please send two alternatives in your timezone and we’ll adapt.

I attached a short intake sheet and a handful of sample payloads to help you see the data we’ll ask for ahead of the call. If you can drop a representative 10–20 sample messages (anonymized) that reflect peak windows, that will speed up the sizing work.

Attachments: finserv_intake.csv (intake template), sample_payloads.json (examples)

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0198

Appreciate the summary. Thu May 27 2:00–3:00 PM PT works best for our team (that’s 5:00–6:00 PM ET). Joining from our side will be: myself, Raj (Head of Platform), and our staff SRE, Jamie Nguyen (jamie.nguyen@finserv-analytics.com).

A couple quick notes from finance/ops: our reconciliation burst typically lasts ~20–30 minutes and is the primary sizing driver. We also have an interactive flow used by traders with smaller payloads and tight latency needs — we estimate 60–80 RPS for that flow with p95 requirement <= 350ms.

Can you also:
- Share a pre-call template (questions we’ll need answered so we can fill the intake before the deep-dive).
- Send SOC2 documentation and a short note on encryption/key management for Private deployments (we may need the info for procurement ahead of the sizing call).

I’ll accept the calendar invite once received.

Thanks —
Samantha Lee
Director, Product Ops | FinServ Analytics
samantha.lee@finserv-analytics.com

Samantha — great, thanks for confirming Thu 27th. Calendar invite created and shared here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

Agenda (30–40 minute deep-dive + 20 min buffer):
1) Quick readout of your precise traffic profile (concurrency, avg/95/max tokens, burst windows).
2) Perf targets and acceptable fallback behavior.
3) Test harness & data ingestion: we’ll walk through the intake template and how to deliver anonymized samples.
4) Sizing recommendations and next steps (pilot timeline).

Per your asks, attaching: mutual_action_plan.md (proposed MAP), finserv_intake.csv (pre-fill), sample_payloads.json (anonymized examples). I’ll also loop in our compliance teammate with SOC2 artifact links — see below.

Pre-call asks (please share before Thu):
- 10–20 anonymized sample payloads representative of each flow (reconciliation vs interactive).
- Peak window schedule (dates/times) and expected duration of bursts.
- Any model/response-quality constraints (e.g., refusal rates, hallucination tolerances).

Compliance links: SOC2 summary + encryption notes: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2-summary (we’ll send the full artifact under NDA or via our secure share).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.md (3KB), finserv_intake.csv (template), sample_payloads.json (5KB)

See you Thu 27th — I’ll add Lauren (SE lead) to run the sizing exercise and Monica (solutions) to capture rollout tasks.

—Markus
